validation_target: evidence/adapters.py via evidence/registry.py (real adapter functions, no mocking) run against artifacts/v2/phase5_benchmark_manifest.json's development+validation splits ONLY (58 of 72 cases). phase5_heldout (14 cases) was NOT touched.

coverage.definition: % of raw input records for which the adapter's produce-N-Evidence-records-or-correctly-skip decision matched the independently authored gold label

source_id_integrity.note: 0/0 confirmed empirically across all 152 real Evidence records produced -- every source_record_id traces to a field verbatim-copied from the real API/local-retrieval response (verified by direct string comparison in the harness), never synthesized.

content_fidelity.definition: % of Evidence.content exactly traceable to the real source record (verbatim text match for PubMed abstracts/chunks, exact field-value match for ClinicalTrials/ChEMBL structured content)

field_path_accuracy.definition: docs/v2/PHASE5_GATE_PLAN.md Section 2 -- % of populated ClinicalTrials/ChEMBL field_path values verified correct against the actual parser code
field_path_accuracy.verified_correct: 100% -- every field_path value adapters.py emits (status/conditions/sponsor/enrollment/start_date/completion_date/brief_summary) was independently re-checked in this task against tools/clinical_trials_tool.py's _parse_study source lines and matches exactly; phase/interventions/locations correctly carry field_path=None since the parser derives/joins those without one fixed source key.

evidence_to_call_id_link.pubmed_rag_call_id_none_by_design: confirmed 100% of PubMed RAG Evidence records carry provenance.call_id=None (N/A by design per contract Section 4 -- never fabricated)
evidence_to_call_id_link.other_sources_call_id_present_when_suppl: 135/152 total Evidence records carry a non-null call_id -- exactly the PubMed-live/ClinicalTrials/ChEMBL records, since the harness supplied a synthetic 'test-call-1' call_id to those adapters (simulating tool_call_history threading) and None to the RAG adapter; no adapter invented its own call_id in either direction.

deduplication.duplicate_evidence_rate: 2 evidence_id values (chembl:CHEMBL941, chembl:CHEMBL25) were each produced by two DIFFERENT benchmark cases (a resolve_compound_name call and a get_drug_info/second-resolve call both naming the same real compound) -- this is CORRECT deterministic behavior (same real source identity -> same evidence_id, contract Section 3), not an accidental merge: inspected by hand, both cases in each pair genuinely refer to the identical real ChEMBL molecule.
deduplication.note: No case where two DISTINCT real source records collapsed to the same evidence_id was found.

serialization.deterministic_evidence_id_stability: Confirmed -- re-running make_evidence_id/adapters on the same stored raw record within this harness (dev+validation re-run, see git history of this run) reproduced identical evidence_id values every time; pure-function construction guarantees this (no randomness/uuid in evidence/models.py).

performance_note: All latencies are pure in-process Python object transformation (no I/O in evidence/adapters.py itself) -- sub-millisecond throughout, as expected for a model-free, network-free adapter layer.
hard_safety_gates_methodology_note: Secret/auth-header-leak scan initially flagged 8 false positives from the substring 'authorization' appearing inside a real trial's own title text ('Post Authorization Study to Monitor...', NCT04887519) -- manually inspected and confirmed benign (no actual API key/token/header value anywhere in any Evidence record); corrected count is 0.

chembl.includes_real_null_pref_name_edge_case: 5 EGFR-target-search molecules with pref_name=None, mechanism_of_action='Not available' from the live API -- adapter correctly raised ValueError/skipped (no fabricated content), matching gold.
